value.name: Ava Community Energy - 'Bright Choice' service
value.notes: Oakland co-founded Ava (then East Bay Community Energy) in 2016 and has automatically enrolled residential, business, and municipal accounts in Ava's Bright Choice service since 2018. PG&E remains the distribution/billing utility; customers may opt out back to PG&E generation at any time. Per source, Bright Choice offers a 0.5% discount on electric supply versus PG&E rates (as of the source's stated snapshot date).

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by PG&E across its entire distribution territory, which includes Oakland/Alameda County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC/PG&E-administered SGIP program and figures confirmed for the San Jose and Fremont pilot records, reused here on the same reasoning: SGIP is administered per IOU distribution territory (PG&E), not per city, and PG&E's distribution role in Oakland is independently confirmed (S2). Confidence held at 0.65, matching Fremont, since this record does not independently re-confirm PG&E's SGIP administrator role specifically for Alameda County. effective_from/expires_on/status follow the same interpretation documented in the prior two records: 'available through 2025' read as expiring 2025-12-31 (end of year, no specific day given), which is before last_verified, hence 'expired'; the other tier's reservation-opening date is directly stated with no stated end/status, hence 'unknown'. Re-check against selfgenca.com's live Program Metrics page before showing as current. Removed the previously-listed "SGIP - Equity Resiliency" line item on 2026-08-09: its expires_on (2025-12-31) has definitively elapsed and no renewal/replacement was confirmed this session, so it no longer represents a current program; the remaining item(s) here are still active/unknown-status per their own status field.
